text: Following 20261118-meta-macbook-20261117-2-8: asked directly in this seat's session, 'You said round four's three fails ... seem right too ("이것도 맞다고 보는게 맞을듯"). What it settles: the person's verdict on the maximal drag coefficient and the times of both maxima of build dfg-cylinder-flow/0001 of run cfd/20261118-7, acceptable, a judgement on that build and not a tolerance.
